title: Proper flat right adjoints preserve support over complements of quasi-compact opens
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let f:X\to Y be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and let a be the right adjoint to Rf_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every quasi-compact open V\subset Y with inverse image U\subset X and every Q in D_QCoh^+(Y) supported on Y\setminus V, the object a(Q) is supported on X\setminus U.
